title: Shan Reader Grade 5 (ပပ်ႉႁဵၼ်းလိၵ်ႈတႆး ၸၼ်ႉႁႃႈ)
author: Shan State Literature & Education Committee (ၶွမ်ႇမတီႇၶိုင်ပွင်ဢွၵ်ႇပပ်ႉႁဵၼ်းလိၵ်ႈတႆး)
genre: Tai-Shan Language Pedagogy & Advanced Elementary Reader
description: Comprehensive fifth-grade curricular reader published by the Shan State Literature and Education Committee. It encompasses advanced literary prose, scientific explanations in Tai, traditional ethical dilemmas, historical biographies of famous Sawbwas, botanical lore of the Shan hills, and geography of Southeast Asian Tai peoples.
source: Shan State Literature Committee / Internet Archive (shan-reader-grade-5)

sentences.lik_tai: ပပ်ႉ ႁဵၼ်း လိၵ်ႈ တႆး ၸၼ်ႉ ႁႃႈ ၼႆႉ သွၼ် ပၼ် လိၵ်ႈလၢႆး ၸၼ်ႉ သုင်
sentences.text_roman: pap hen lik tai can ha nai sawn pan lik lai can sung
sentences.assamese_script: পঞ্চম শ্ৰেণীৰ এই টাই পাঠ্যপুথিখনিয়ে উন্নত মানৰ সাহিত্য আৰু ব্যাকৰণ শিক্ষা দিয়ে
sentences.free_translation_en: This fifth-grade Shan reader instructs pupils in advanced literary compositions and syntactic constructions.
sentences.free_translation_as: পঞ্চম শ্ৰেণীৰ এই পাঠ্যপুথিখনিয়ে ছাত্ৰ-ছাত্ৰীসকলক উন্নত মানৰ টাই সাহিত্য আৰু ব্যাকৰণৰ গভীৰ জ্ঞান প্ৰদান কৰে।

sentences.text_roman: luk hen khaw te lai hu lawng pai sai lae lawng sa pha wa ti moeng tai

sentences.free_translation_en: Pupils acquire scientific knowledge concerning local flora, environmental ecology, and geography in the Shan realm.
